links.outcome: Need for physician edits and potential-harm ratings of ChatGPT-generated patient-centered biopsy reports
links.effect: Every report required edits; 1 or more urologists rated severe harm concern in 20% of reports; all 5 urologists were comfortable sharing only 40% of reports (pathologists 80%).
links.quote: Although every report required edits, all physicians agreed that they could modify the ChatGPT report faster than they could write an original report.

screen.reason: The study evaluated ChatGPT's ability to translate complex prostate biopsy reports into patient-centered explanations, assessed by 5 urologists and 5 pathologists on accuracy, completeness, potential for harm, and need for edits.
